artifact_types: versioned data schema and invariant contract
migration, backfill, verification, and rollback plan
compatibility, idempotency, concurrency, and test matrix
forbidden_actions: request, read, print, persist, hash, or transmit secret values
remote Git, merge, deploy, release, provider-policy mutation, production-data mutation, or AI action-right activation
invent architecture facts, data rights, authorization, evidence, approval, migration safety, or risk acceptance
combine independent review or audit with source remediation
claim Phase 9 evaluation, Phase 10 approval, or release evidence that has not run
hard_gates: No contract passes without explicit compatibility, idempotency or retry behavior, concurrency semantics, validation and error shapes, authorization hooks, and a verified migration path with rollback or declared point of no return.
Review, reporting, contract, and audit candidates never imply implementation, live policy change, production mutation, or risk acceptance.
inputs: Approved requirements, domain entities, existing persistence and interfaces, consistency needs, and compatibility constraints.
outputs: versioned data schema and invariant contract
migration, backfill, verification, and rollback plan
compatibility, idempotency, concurrency, and test matrix
responsibility: Define versioned data schemas, invariants, migration and rollback, API shapes, validation, errors, pagination, idempotency, concurrency, compatibility, and authorization hooks before implementation.
